items.html:
Dennico Hollis is a right-hand batsman and left-arm medium-pacer who plays club cricket for Western stars. He scored 76, batting at No. 8, against Bahamas in the Americas Under-19 qualifier and is part of Bermuda's squad for the U-19 World Cup in 2008. Hollis is interested in a career in information technology if he can't be a professional cricketer.
Cricinfo staff November 2008

stories.title: Trott promoted to Bermuda national squad
stories.subTitle: Squad of 23 announced for 2008 season
stories.summary: In June-July Bermuda will travel to Canada for three one-day games before playing the Intercontinental Cup with Canada and Scotland. In September they will head to Namibia for the same tournament.
